projects.name: 01ai · 01 family
projects.brief:
01ai: the private agentic AI chat and tools, used only by Nicolas and his team. A showcase, not a sales site: "The most spectacular agentic chat interface ever created." The feeling to leave with: "I want this, and I probably can't get it." Intelligent, elegant, intimidating, exclusive, alive, powerful, precise, expensive.

The family: 01ai (name locked), 01 Agency (client-facing agency site), 01 Workspace (the HUD dashboard). Agency and Workspace face customers, so the system has to hold up there too.

Voice: larger than life. A showman with total confidence, no hedging. "The most powerful agentic AI." "1000+ models, and more always coming." "Endless skills." "Adaptive routing." "The best agents." "The maximum power stack."

Home: city circuits, a motherboard laid out like a city (chips are towers, traces are streets, light is constant traffic). Angled, deep, off-centre camera, asymmetric, layered parallax. Logo top left. Top right: SERVER v1.0 // NODE: WAR ROOM // UPTIME 99.999%. Big headline "The most powerful agentic system." with "Coordinated. Adaptive. Unyielding." Animated war-room feeds at the bottom. Apply small but findable; login discreet. No DNA on home.

Agents page: a faint, small binary DNA strand of 0s and 1s that splits and recombines into new agents.
Other pieces: about 60 real integration logos; a ticker of the 40 most valuable companies "powered by 01ai" (with permission only); origin story (100+ coders, 4 continents, 3+ years, constantly updating); a long, demanding application emailed to Nicolas.
Motion: its own style. Sound: ticks, buzzes, high pitches. Colour: dark graphite, platinum type, cyan secondary, small purple/green/amber accents.
Avoid: callout cards, any "by invitation only" text (scarcity framing like "01ai is not available." is now on-brand), a small headline, a hard-to-read logo, overhead or symmetrical views, an oversized DNA strand.
projects.decisions:
Building blocks in the atlas (Interactions shelf, Signal & data). Each is one HTML file with a CONFIG block:
- Status header with discreet login: https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#status-header
- Circuit city hero (3D): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#circuit-city
- Binary helix (Agents page): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#binary-helix
- Live telemetry feeds (war room): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#telemetry-feeds
- Routed motion kit (route, lock, decode, tick): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#routed-motion
- Machine sound kit: https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#machine-sounds
- Integration logo wall (76 marks): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#integration-wall
- Follow-the-sun board (origin story): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#follow-the-sun
- Hairline claims and roster (no cards): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#hairline-lists
- Long staged application: https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#staged-application (POST to /api/apply; needs RESEND_API_KEY and APPLY_TO on Vercel)
- Agent console (the chat showpiece): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#agent-console
- Powered-by ticker: use the Logo cloud marquee, https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/interactions.html#sec-logos
Theme kit 09, Graphite (tokens, components, live background, zip): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/theme-kits.html#graphite

Decisions so far:
- Motion language is "routed": things arrive along a trace, lock into place, decode from 0s and 1s, and numbers tick in steps.
- Frames use corner ticks and hairlines instead of boxed cards.
- Sound is off until the visitor turns it on.
- Still to do in-house: final copy, real ticker names (with permission), and real team hubs and dates for the origin story.
- An earlier full prototype of the 01ai pages is kept in the motionatlas git history (commit be741b5, folder site/work/01).

Brand Kit v2 (current): https://motionatlas-ten.vercel.app/work/01/brand-kit
- Logo: bold monospace "01ai" with a slashed zero (Geist Mono Bold, outlined). App icon: "01" plus a cyan caret in a graphite tile.
- Two modes: graphite (dark) and concrete (light, #ECEEF0 with graphite ink). Cyan stays the signal; amber and green as small accents.
- Type: Geist Mono for logo, labels, stats and tabs; Source Serif 4 600 for the scarcity headline; Geist for body.
- Scarcity is now on-brand: "01ai is not available." with ticking stats (Applications, Active Users) and "Request access." Never "by invitation only".
- Concept films (10s, 1280x720): sphere, capsule, stack in work/01/films/. Home directions 21 Sphere, 22 Capsule and 23 Stack use them as full-bleed heroes with live overlays.
- Live components: leader-line annotations, the status block, the typing headline and the mono tab bar (work/01/01-brand.css + 01-brand.js).

notes.L05: Every headline decodes from 0s and 1s. Use the Routed motion kit decode().
notes.L01: Pointer parallax and scroll dolly for the city-circuit camera. Keep it angled, never overhead.
notes.M11: Depth through fog layers in the 3D city.
notes.L11: "Powered by 01ai" ticker with a pause control.
notes.A03: War-room feeds: clean mono data that ticks in steps, no CRT scanlines.
notes.S19: Terminal grammar for the machine voice only (status line, logs), never for body copy.
notes.M02: Short 14ms staggers with a hard lock.
notes.E09: Read as what NOT to do: replace cards with corner ticks and hairlines.
notes.D08: Token structure starting point; swap neon for graphite and platinum.
notes.A25: Sound kit idea: the interface makes the sound.
